findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the ice machine interior has an accumulation of debris. Food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of debris. The inspector will follow-up on 12/1/2025 to check that the ice machine has been cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed the women’s restroom does not have a covered waste receptacle for sanitary napkins. Ensure that the women’s restroom has a covered waste receptacle by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Inspector observed two five pound containers of commercially prepared roast beef in the small chest freezer. The food must be removed or discarded. The facility has a low risk permit with a variance for frozen pizza service. No other TCS foods shall be served from the facility. Prepackaged snack foods are acceptable to serve under this permit. 

3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled. (E) WHOLE-MUSCLE BEEF shall be from approved source and acceptable from AUTHROITY. Pf (D) FISH must be frozen if consumed undercooked. (F) Meat and Poultry shall be properly labeled. (G) Eggs shall be properly labeled. C

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Inspector observed boxes of packaged snacks on the floor in the facility. The food shall be stored no less than six inches above the floor. Store food properly protected in the facility.

3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed single use plates, cups, towels on the floor in the facility. Store single use items properly, six inches above the floor. 

4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
The facility could not produce chemical sanitizer test kits at the time of inspection. The facility uses both bleach and quat sanitizers. Provide Chlorine and Quaternary Ammonia test kits by 11/27/23.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a single burner, air fryer, and at least 6 crock pots and an large electric roaster oven. These items must be removed from the facility as they are unnecessary for the operation of the establishment. 

6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment: Ice scoop is observed stored on a piece of plastic on top of a clean rag sitting on top of the ice machine which is adjacent to and at the same level as the bar. Store ice scoop clean and dry and protected from contamination. 3-304.12  (C) Store in-use utensils: 1) in the food with the handle above the top of the food item; 2) on a clean and sanitized surface; 3) in running water; 4) in a container of hot water maintained at or above 135 °F. Reference 3-304.12.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: From the pre-opening: 1) the 2X4 to the left of the three compartment sink is not smooth and easily cleanable. Seal bare wood. 2) Seal bare wood shelves inside cabinets opposite the three compartment sink where contact paper has been removed. 3) Paint or seal wall above hand sink in women's restroom. 6-201.11  (C) Floors, Walls and Ceilings were found in a state of disrepair, or not to be smooth and easily cleanable. Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed wet wiping cloths stored on the bar. The cloths were stored in a sanitizer solution during the inspection.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice machine flap to have some mold accumulation. The ice machine was cleaned during the inspection.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice machine deflector shield to be soiled with what appears to be mold. Wash, rinse, and sanitize the ice machine deflector shield.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
REPEAT 1x> Observed a box of chips stored on the floor of the back storage room. Properly store all food and food service items at least 6" above the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the wood shelf attached to the right of the 3 part sink to be coming deattached and is a raw wood surface. Re-attach shelf or remove. Shelf also needs to be painted or sealed to make for a non-absorbent and easily cleanable surface. 2) Side of hand sink at the far end of the bar has raw wood. Paint or seal wood.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT 1x> Observed the pizza oven in the kitchen to be soiled. Clean and sanitize the oven and grate.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 1) Observed multiple broken, cracked, and chipped floor tiles in the men's restroom. Replace damaged floor tiles to make for a smooth and cleanable surface. REPEAT 2x> 2) Originally noted in the 10/25/2010 inspection, there are several spots around the bar where the floor is soft or in some stage of disrepair. The floor around the ice machine, sinks, and reach in cooler is of particular concern. The floor is cracked and splintering under the floor mats. Provide properly constructed floors to make for a cleanable surface. 3) Observed the floor under the bar to be soiled with an accumulation of litter. Clean floor. 750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the wall and cove base to the left of the men's restroom toiled to be in disrepair. Wall is heavily damaged and should be replaced to make sure there are no holes and can be easily cleaned. Provide properly constructed wall and cove base.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
